# ![標題](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df2a896fab1a2ae6ea128221efd962b06bf33b29.png)

[![Modrinth 連結](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg&;n=-1)](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-backport)
[![CurseForge 連結](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_vector.svg&;n=-1)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/copper-backport)

這個模組將後續版本《Minecraft》中新增的銅製盔甲與工具組，帶回較早且受模組社群歡迎的遊戲版本中。

_來看看銅製工具組、盔甲套裝，沒錯，**甚至還有銅粒**！_
